review_scope: Independent reading of the retained original publisher PDF and visual inspection of Tables 2 and 3. Proposed candidate facts were checked against the primary document, not accepted as source evidence. This artifact supports a qualified factual transcription only; identity eligibility, catalog integration, scientific approval and rights review remain separate decisions.

formulation_basis.locator: PDF p.2 section 2.1; p.3 Table 1, section 2.3 and Table 2
formulation_basis.matrix: PBS/PBAT with the source-selected internal ratio 70:30
formulation_basis.matrix_ratio_basis: Not specified. Do not label 70:30 as a measured mass, molar or volume fraction.

constituent_identity.pbs: Biobased polybutylene succinate; Table 1 input trade name Bio PBS FZ 91, PTT MCC BIOCHEM, Thailand.
constituent_identity.pbat: Polybutylene adipate-co-terephthalate; Table 1 input trade name Eco flex C1200, BASF, Germany.
constituent_identity.lignin: The methods identify SAPPI-supplied lignosulphonate. Tables 2 and 3 use the shorter label lignin; retain this mapping explicitly.
constituent_identity.zno: Zinc oxide nanoparticles synthesized in section 2.2; do not substitute elemental zinc despite the shorter zinc wording in the article title.

formulation_basis.reported_loadings: Section 2.3 calls lignosulphonate loadings 5 to 15 wt.% and the constant ZnO loading 1.5 wt.%. Table 2 lists the three matrix/lignin/ZnO entries as 95/5/1.5, 90/10/1.5 and 85/15/1.5.
formulation_basis.denominator_limit: Each filled Table 2 row sums to 101.5. The article does not resolve the ZnO percentage denominator or make these entries a normalized total-composite mass-fraction recipe. Preserve the source entries and nominal loading language without normalizing by 101.5, silently rescaling the matrix, or inferring exact constituent fractions.
formulation_basis.final_composition_assay: Not reported for these selected formulation identities. The entries describe source input formulations, not measured final composition.
formulation_basis.table_mapping: Table 3 labels the three filled rows by matrix/lignin ratios and omits ZnO from their row labels. Table 2 and sections 2.3 and 2.6.2 explicitly establish that these three hybrid-composite groups contain the constant source-reported 1.5 wt.% ZnO. The mapping therefore requires those method locators as well as Table 3.
formulation_basis.identity_scope: Three study-specific composite formulations differ in nominal lignosulphonate loading. Specimen count, processing conditions and commercial input names are contextual metadata, not additional material identities. Catalog novelty requires a separate current-catalog check; this source review does not assert universal chemical uniqueness.

processing_context.polymer_predrying: 80 °C overnight before processing; no numerical overnight duration is inferred.
processing_context.forming: Co-rotating twin-screw extrusion, model TE-30/600-11-40, L/D 40:1, heating zones 120 to 145 °C; pelletization; 80 °C drying for 24 h; injection moulding with ENGEL e-mac50, source-reported 500 kN, and heating zones 120 to 145 °C to produce dog-bone specimens.
processing_context.storage: Injection-moulded specimens were cooled at room temperature and stored in a zip-lock bag before analysis; no cooling rate or storage duration is inferred.
processing_context.limit: These are reported study preparation conditions, not a complete validated manufacturing specification or an independent reason to create additional identities.

property_contract.locator: PDF p.7 Table 3, tensile-modulus column and the three filled-hybrid rows
property_contract.central_estimator: Not specified. Store the displayed central value as reported; five tested specimens do not establish an arithmetic mean or median.
property_contract.plus_minus_semantics: Not specified. Preserve the displayed plus/minus amplitude and original unit; do not label it SD, SE, a confidence interval, a range or a propagated measurement uncertainty.

sample_count.limit: The source does not establish five independent manufacturing batches or disclose raw specimen-level values.

property_contract.test_method: Instron tensile tester, source-stated ASTM D638, applied to dog-bone specimens.
property_contract.test_standard_scope: ASTM D638 is the source's statement; no edition or independent standard-compliance verification is provided.
unreported_or_unresolved: Tensile crosshead speed or strain rate
Numerical specimen dimensions, gauge length and test-standard specimen type
Numerical modulus-fit strain interval and fitting procedure
Central aggregation and meaning of the plus/minus amplitudes
Independent specimen-level raw data and batch variability
property_contract.scope_limit: The values characterize the reported formulations and preparation/test context. They are not universal constants, a comparison adjusted for all test differences, or a validated biomedical-performance claim. No extrapolation, numerical normalization, curve digitization or derived material-property estimate was used.

required_qualifications: Preserve both the unresolved internal 70:30 ratio basis and the 101.5-sum/ZnO-denominator issue.
Preserve the Table 2-to-Table 3 mapping and the lignin-to-lignosulphonate identity mapping.
Preserve reported units, specimen count, conditioning, test temperature and source-stated method together with the unreported statistical and method fields.
Retain source-specific attribution and separate factual transcription from scientific approval, catalog novelty/admission and legal clearance.
review_outcome.limits: No supplementary file, original structure asset, raw measurement set or biomedical validation was obtained. PDF p.12 says underlying data are available on request; no request to the authors was made. This review does not authorize promotion of unreviewed computed examples or changes to the formal main catalog.
